    What you can say
    • “Scroll down”, “Scroll up”, “Next”, “Back”, “Go to the top”
    • Any dish name: “Sushi pizza”, “Poke bowl”, “Miso soup”, “Next dish”
    • “Remove kanikama”, “Add back kanikama”, “Show me the avocado”
    • “Read this”, “What’s in it?”, “Stop”
    • “Start the tour”, “Pause”, “Continue”, “Skip”, “Faster”, “Slower”
    • “Add to cart”, “Open cart”, “Menu”, “View in AR”, “Close”
    • “No shellfish” or any allergy, “Help”
    • If the mic stops, tap the round mic button and speak.
